summary: The note describes Vennaimalai, a village in Karur District of Tamil Nadu, India, situated near the cities of Karur and Tiruchirappalli. It is described as one of the residential areas of Karur District and is known for the Balasubramaniyaswamy Temple.
one_line: Vennaimalai is a residential village in Karur District, Tamil Nadu, India, known for the Balasubramaniyaswamy Temple.
key_facts: Vennaimalai is a village of Karur District in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.
Vennaimalai is located near Karur and Tiruchirappalli.
Vennaimalai is one of the residential areas in Karur District.
Vennaimalai is known for the Balasubramaniyaswamy Temple.
